title: Decoupling Patient Personas and Clinical Workflows: A Dual-Agent Approach to Realistic Medical Dialogue Generation
title_zh: 解耦患者画像与临床工作流：一种用于真实医疗对话生成的双智能体方法

paragraphs.en: Pre-consultation medical dialogues are essential for collecting comprehensive patient information, but are costly to obtain at scale due to privacy and ethical constraints. Existing LLM-based synthesis methods often rely on prompt engineering or rigid rules, limiting their ability to balance clinical relevance with realistic patient diversity. We propose CoRPS-Dial , a controllable dual-agent framework for pre-consultation medical dialogue synthesis that integrates patient personas with guideline-aligned clinical workflow rules. CoRPS-Dial generates dialogues through interactions between a persona-driven patient agent and a process-guided doctor agent, followed by post-hoc quality control for role consistency, workflow completeness, and textual consistency. Experiments on coronary heart disease demonstrate that CoRPS-Dial improves alignment between synthetic and real dialogues in information coverage, clinical compliance, and dialogue naturalness. Downstream fine-tuning experiments further confirm the utility of the generated synthetic data for medical dialogue tasks. These results highlight the effectiveness of CoRPS-Dial for clinically grounded and controllable medical dialogue synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 预问诊医疗对话对于收集全面的患者信息至关重要，但由于隐私和伦理限制，大规模获取成本很高。 现有的基于大语言模型的合成方法通常依赖提示工程或僵化的规则，限制了其在临床相关性与真实患者多样性之间取得平衡的能力。 我们提出 CoRPS-Dial，一个用于预问诊医疗对话合成的可控双智能体框架，它将患者画像与符合临床指南的工作流规则相结合。 CoRPS-Dial 通过画像驱动的患者智能体与流程引导的医生智能体之间的交互来生成对话，随后进行事后质量控制，以确保角色一致性、工作流完整性和文本一致性。 在冠心病上的实验表明，CoRPS-Dial 在信息覆盖率、临床合规性和对话自然度方面提升了合成对话与真实对话之间的一致性。 下游微调实验进一步证实了所生成合成数据在医疗对话任务中的实用性。 这些结果凸显了 CoRPS-Dial 在基于临床且可控的医疗对话合成方面的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Pre-consultation medical dialogues are crucial for gathering comprehensive patient information for effective triage and diagnostic decision-making ( Yu et al., 2025 ) . High-quality multi-turn dialogues are also valuable for training medical dialogue systems to emulate diagnostic reasoning. However, acquiring large-scale real-world doctor–patient dialogues is challenging due to privacy regulations, ethical constraints, and expensive expert annotation, particularly for specialized diseases with complex clinical workflows and strict information requirements.

paragraphs.en: To alleviate dialogue scarcity, recent efforts have leveraged large language models (LLMs) to generate or assist in generating medical dialogues ( Qiu et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) , typically through prompt engineering or template-based designs (Figure 1 (a)). While these approaches demonstrate strong multi-turn generation ability, their clinical reliability is limited by implicit parametric knowledge and hallucinated content. To improve controllability, prior work incorporates explicit clinical rules ( Wang et al., 2024 ) (Figure 1 (b)) or hybrid rule–reward mechanisms ( Ge et al., 2025 ) (Figure 1 (c)). However, existing methods still face a trade-off between scalability and reliability: fine-grained control often depends on expert-designed rules and manual verification, while iterative multi-turn control increases pipeline complexity and may reduce dialogue consistency. These limitations are particularly critical in pre-consultation settings, where patient presentations exhibit substantial heterogeneity in symptoms, emotions, and communication styles, while pre-consultation interviews must follow structured, guideline-informed workflows. Existing approaches couple these objectives within a single generation process, limiting independent control.
paragraphs.zh: 为了缓解对话数据稀缺的问题，近期的工作利用大语言模型（LLMs）来生成或辅助生成医疗对话（Qiu et al., 2024; Xie et al., 2025; Chen et al., 2023; Zhang et al., 2024），通常采用提示工程或基于模板的设计（图 1 (a)）。 虽然这些方法展现出较强的多轮生成能力，但其临床可靠性受限于隐式的参数化知识和幻觉内容。 为了提高可控性，先前的工作引入了显式的临床规则（Wang et al., 2024）（图 1 (b)）或规则—奖励混合机制（Ge et al., 2025）（图 1 (c)）。 然而，现有方法仍面临可扩展性与可靠性之间的权衡：细粒度控制通常依赖专家设计的规则和人工验证，而迭代式的多轮控制会增加流程复杂度并可能降低对话一致性。 这些局限在预问诊场景中尤为突出：患者的主诉在症状、情绪和沟通风格上呈现出显著的异质性，而预问诊问诊又必须遵循结构化的、由临床指南引导的工作流程。 现有方法将这些目标耦合在单一的生成过程中，限制了独立控制。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we propose a controllable dual-agent framework, CoRPS-Dial, that explicitly decouples patient heterogeneity from guideline-aligned clinical process modeling (Figure 1 (d)). Specifically, patient personas are constructed from a seed set of real, de-identified cardiology consultations transcribed from clinical audio recordings, capturing demographic attributes, health conditions, emotions, and communication styles. In parallel, guideline-aligned clinical process rules explicitly encode workflow structure and clinical priorities. Dialogue generation is realized through interactions between a persona-driven patient agent and a process-guided doctor agent, followed by a post-hoc quality control pipeline that ensures medical consistency and workflow completeness via rule-based checks, reward scoring, and selective refinement. Experiments on coronary heart disease (CHD) demonstrate the effectiveness of CoRPS-Dial for controllable and clinically grounded medical dialogue synthesis. Downstream fine-tuning further validates the utility of the generated synthetic data for medical dialogue tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种可控的双智能体框架 CoRPS-Dial，它显式地将患者异质性与符合指南的临床过程建模解耦（图 1 (d)）。 具体而言，患者人设由一组来自真实、去标识化心脏病学临床问诊（由临床录音转写而成）的种子集构建，涵盖人口统计学属性、健康状况、情绪和沟通风格。 与此同时，符合指南的临床过程规则显式地编码了工作流结构和临床优先级。 对话生成通过基于人设的患者智能体与基于过程引导的医生智能体之间的交互实现，随后由事后质量控制流程通过基于规则的检查、奖励评分和选择性修正来确保医学一致性和工作流完整性。 在冠心病（CHD）上的实验证明了 CoRPS-Dial 在可控且具有临床依据的医学对话合成方面的有效性。 下游微调进一步验证了所生成的合成数据在医学对话任务中的实用性。

paragraphs.en: Current medical dialogues can be broadly categorized into two main types: those derived from real doctor–patient interactions, and those generated through human annotation or model-based synthesis ( Li et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 当前的医学对话大致可以分为两大类：一类源自真实的医患互动，另一类则通过人工标注或基于模型的合成方式生成（ Li et al., 2025 ）。

paragraphs.en: Real-World Medical Dialogues are typically sourced from clinical practices or online medical consultation platforms, capturing authentic doctor–patient interactions and natural language expression habits. Representative dialogues include WebMedQA ( He et al., 2019 ) , cMedQA2 ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , iCliniq-10k ( Li et al., 2023 ) , HealthCareMagic100k ( Li et al., 2023 ) , MedDialog ( Zeng et al., 2020 ) , Huatuo-26M ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , Chinese medical dialogues 1 1 1 https://github.com/Toyhom/Chinese-medical-dialogue-data covering six specialties, and CMtMedQA ( Yang et al., 2024b ) , which spans 14 medical departments and multiple medical question-answering (Q&A) scenarios. These dialogues offer clear advantages in terms of coverage across medical domains and scales. However, most focus on general or multi-disciplinary scenarios and mainly consist of single-turn Q&A pairs or weakly structured interactions, making them insufficient for disease-specific pre-consultation scenarios requiring specialized medical knowledge and strict clinical workflows. In addition, privacy and ethical constraints limit the availability, scalability and reusability of authentic doctor–patient dialogues.

paragraphs.en: Synthetic Medical Dialogues have recently been explored to alleviate the scarcity of real-world dialogues, with LLMs used to generate or assist in generating them. LLM-generated dialogue offers stronger controllability, lower privacy risk, and greater scalability through prompt engineering or template-based designs. Prior studies such as ChatMed-Consult ( Zhu and Wang, 2023 ) , GenMedGPT-5k ( Li et al., 2023 ) , and RJUA-QA ( Lyu et al., 2023 ) generate medical Q&A pairs or simulated consultations, while more recent works, including SmileChat ( Qiu et al., 2024 ) , PsyDTCorpus ( Xie et al., 2025 ) , SoulChatCorpus ( Chen et al., 2023 ) , and CPsyCounD ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , extend synthesis to multi-turn interactions. However, these approaches remain limited by hallucinations and weak clinical grounding, which can reduce clinical reliability and professional accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 合成医疗对话近来被探索用于缓解真实世界对话的稀缺问题，其生成或辅助生成由大语言模型完成。 通过提示工程或基于模板的设计，大语言模型生成的对话具有更强的可控性、更低的隐私风险和更好的可扩展性。 先前的研究，如 ChatMed-Consult（Zhu and Wang, 2023）、GenMedGPT-5k（Li et al., 2023）和 RJUA-QA（Lyu et al., 2023），生成医疗问答对或模拟问诊，而更近期的工作，包括 SmileChat（Qiu et al., 2024）、PsyDTCorpus（Xie et al., 2025）、SoulChatCorpus（Chen et al., 2023）和 CPsyCounD（Zhang et al., 2024），将合成扩展到多轮交互。 然而，这些方法仍受幻觉和临床依据薄弱的限制，这会降低临床可靠性和专业准确性。

sents.en: Synthetic Medical Dialogues have recently been explored to alleviate the scarcity of real-world dialogues, with LLMs used to generate or assist in generating them.
sents.zh: 合成医疗对话近来被探索用于缓解真实世界对话的稀缺问题，其生成或辅助生成由大语言模型完成。

sents.en: LLM-generated dialogue offers stronger controllability, lower privacy risk, and greater scalability through prompt engineering or template-based designs.
sents.zh: 通过提示工程或基于模板的设计，大语言模型生成的对话具有更强的可控性、更低的隐私风险和更好的可扩展性。

sents.en: Prior studies such as ChatMed-Consult ( Zhu and Wang, 2023 ) , GenMedGPT-5k ( Li et al., 2023 ) , and RJUA-QA ( Lyu et al., 2023 ) generate medical Q&A pairs or simulated consultations, while more recent works, including SmileChat ( Qiu et al., 2024 ) , PsyDTCorpus ( Xie et al., 2025 ) , SoulChatCorpus ( Chen et al., 2023 ) , and CPsyCounD ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , extend synthesis to multi-turn interactions.
sents.zh: 先前的研究，如 ChatMed-Consult（Zhu and Wang, 2023）、GenMedGPT-5k（Li et al., 2023）和 RJUA-QA（Lyu et al., 2023），生成医疗问答对或模拟问诊，而更近期的工作，包括 SmileChat（Qiu et al., 2024）、PsyDTCorpus（Xie et al., 2025）、SoulChatCorpus（Chen et al., 2023）和 CPsyCounD（Zhang et al., 2024），将合成扩展到多轮交互。

sents.en: However, these approaches remain limited by hallucinations and weak clinical grounding, which can reduce clinical reliability and professional accuracy.
sents.zh: 然而，这些方法仍受幻觉和临床依据薄弱的限制，这会降低临床可靠性和专业准确性。

paragraphs.en: To improve clinical plausibility, recent studies incorporate clinical rules or hybrid rule-and-reward quality control mechanisms. For example, Wang et al. ( Wang et al., 2024 ) transform single-turn Q&A into workflow-aligned multi-turn dialogue skeletons with rule constraints and expert review, while Ge et al. ( Ge et al., 2025 ) combine intent planning, dual-agent simulation, and rule–reward mechanisms for step-wise medical dialogue generation. However, these methods often rely heavily on expert involvement or lack explicit alignment with standardized clinical guidelines, limiting scalability and robustness in disease-specific pre-consultation scenarios with complex workflows. Moreover, enforcing medical constraints during online generation can reduce global dialogue consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 为了提升临床合理性，近期研究引入了临床规则或规则与奖励相结合的质量控制机制。例如，Wang 等人 （Wang et al., 2024）通过规则约束与专家审查，将单轮问答转化为与工作流程对齐的多轮对话骨架；而 Ge 等人 （Ge et al., 2025）则结合意图规划、双智能体模拟以及规则–奖励机制，实现逐步式的医疗对话生成。 然而，这些方法通常严重依赖专家参与，或缺乏与标准化临床指南的显式对齐，限制了其在工作流程复杂、针对特定疾病的预问诊场景中的可扩展性与鲁棒性。 此外，在在线生成过程中强制施加医疗约束可能会降低对话的全局一致性。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we propose a dual-agent framework that integrates patient personas with guideline-aligned workflow rules to achieve controllable and clinically reliable pre-consultation dialogue synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一个双智能体框架，该框架将患者画像与符合临床指南的工作流规则相结合，以实现可控且临床可靠的预问诊对话合成。

paragraphs.en: We construct a seed dialogue set in collaboration with a tertiary hospital cardiology department using real outpatient pre-consultation recordings. Audio recordings are transcribed with automatic speech recognition and structured by DeepSeek-R1-14B ( Guo et al., 2025 ) for role identification and turn segmentation. Both models are deployed locally to ensure privacy compliance. Six trained annotators manually verify the transcripts against the original recordings, producing a high-quality de-identified seed dialogue set grounded in real clinical practice. To preserve clinically meaningful patient heterogeneity, we retain informative signals while filtering surface-level noise and irregularities (Appendix A.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们与某三级医院心脏内科合作，利用真实的门诊预问诊录音构建了一个种子对话集。 录音通过自动语音识别进行转写，并由DeepSeek-R1-14B（Guo et al., 2025）进行结构化处理，以完成角色识别和话轮切分。 两个模型均在本地部署，以确保隐私合规。 六名经过培训的标注员对照原始录音人工核验转写文本，最终得到了一个扎根于真实临床实践、经去标识化处理的高质量种子对话集。 为保留具有临床意义的患者异质性，我们在过滤表面层面的噪声与不规范内容的同时，保留了有价值的信息信号（附录A.1）。

paragraphs.en: To complement guideline-defined workflows with disease-specific nuances and follow-up patterns, we mine frequent inquiry transitions and conditional triggers from real-world consultations D real D_{\text{real}} (size N N , covering M M cases of the target disease). The resulting tree 𝒯 \mathcal{T} preserves mandatory guideline items and safety constraints while augmenting them with empirically validated optional branches, improving alignment with real clinical practice. During dialogue generation, the doctor agent traverses 𝒯 \mathcal{T} to select the next inquiry, prioritizing mandatory nodes while allowing flexible LLM-based realization, thereby decoupling workflow control from language generation.

paragraphs.en: We perform a hybrid hard–soft evaluation to optimize low-quality outputs efficiently.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用硬–软混合评估方式来高效优化低质量输出。

paragraphs.en: First, a deterministic rule-based validator enforces strict compliance on four critical dimensions:
paragraphs.zh: 首先，一个确定性的基于规则的验证器在四个关键维度上强制执行严格合规：

paragraphs.en: Role Consistency : Whether the questions and answers align with the roles of the patient, doctor, or family member.
paragraphs.zh: 角色一致性：问题和答案是否符合患者、医生或家属的角色定位。

paragraphs.en: Process Consistency : Whether the process aligns with mandatory nodes in 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , follows the correct order without violating red flags or dependencies.
paragraphs.zh: 过程一致性：过程是否符合 𝒯 \mathcal{T} 中的强制节点，是否遵循正确的顺序，且未违反红旗警示或依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: Contextual Coherence : Whether the dialogue history contains contradictions in terms of symptom facts, timelines, or medical logic.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文连贯性：对话历史中是否在症状事实、时间线或医学逻辑方面存在矛盾。

paragraphs.en: Basic Text Quality : Whether there are any formatting errors, incorrect medical terms, unsafe content, or violations of guidelines 𝒢 \mathcal{G} .
paragraphs.zh: 基础文本质量：是否存在格式错误、不正确的医学术语、不安全内容，或违反准则 𝒢 \mathcal{G} 的情况。

paragraphs.en: Violations trigger immediate flagging for revision.
paragraphs.zh: 违规会立即被标记以供修订。

paragraphs.en: Second, we use the GLM-4-9B ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) to score the entire dialogue across the same dimensions on a 1–10 Likert scale (details in Appendix A.2 ). If the average reward R ⁡ ( 𝒟 ) R(\mathcal{D}) is below a threshold θ \theta (average reward score of real dialogues under the same dimensions and GLM-4-9B scoring), the dialogue is selected for refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，我们使用 GLM-4-9B（Zeng et al., 2024）按照相同的维度对整个对话进行 1–10 李克特量表打分（详见附录 A.2）。 如果平均奖励 R(𝒟) 低于阈值 θ（即在相同维度下使用 GLM-4-9B 对真实对话打出的平均奖励分数），则该对话将被选中进行精炼。

sents.en: Second, we use the GLM-4-9B ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) to score the entire dialogue across the same dimensions on a 1–10 Likert scale (details in Appendix A.2 ).
sents.zh: 其次，我们使用 GLM-4-9B（Zeng et al., 2024）按照相同的维度对整个对话进行 1–10 李克特量表打分（详见附录 A.2）。

sents.en: If the average reward R ⁡ ( 𝒟 ) R(\mathcal{D}) is below a threshold θ \theta (average reward score of real dialogues under the same dimensions and GLM-4-9B scoring), the dialogue is selected for refinement.
sents.zh: 如果平均奖励 R(𝒟) 低于阈值 θ（即在相同维度下使用 GLM-4-9B 对真实对话打出的平均奖励分数），则该对话将被选中进行精炼。

paragraphs.en: This hard-first, soft-second pipeline eliminates critical errors while leveraging GLM-4-9B’s strong discriminative ability and effectiveness in reward modeling for nuanced assessment ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , achieving high reliability with modest compute overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 这种「先硬后软」的流水线消除了关键错误，同时利用 GLM-4-9B 强大的判别能力及其在奖励建模中用于细致评估的有效性（Zhang et al., 2025），以适度的计算开销实现了高可靠性。

paragraphs.en: For flagged utterances, we perform targeted revision instead of full regeneration. An LLM is prompted with the original utterance, dialogue context h t h_{t} , patient profile p ′ p^{\prime} , and specific error feedback from the assessment stage (e.g., “resolve symptom inconsistency between turns 3 and 5”). The revised utterance replaces the original only if its reward score improves. This iterative, selective strategy preserves dialogue structure, minimizes compute cost, and yields clinically grounded, high-quality synthetic dialogues.
paragraphs.zh: 对于被标记的话语，我们进行针对性修改，而不是完整重新生成。 我们向大语言模型提供原始话语、对话上下文 h t h_{t} 、患者档案 p ′ p^{\prime} 以及来自评估阶段的具体错误反馈（例如，“解决第3轮与第5轮之间的症状不一致”）。 只有当奖励分数有所提升时，修改后的话语才会替换原始话语。 这种迭代式的选择性策略保留了对话结构，最大限度降低了计算成本，并生成了具有临床依据的高质量合成对话。

paragraphs.en: We collected 256 real-world pre-consultation dialogues from the Department of Cardiology, covering chief complaints, present illness history, and relevant risk factors for patients suspected of CHD. The pre-consultation phase focused on collecting information, without involving final diagnostic confirmation. We extracted these dialogues as seed patient profiles and augmented them via controlled perturbations along emotional state and communication style, generating 5,120 profiles. Each profile generated 1–3 multi-turn dialogues, resulting in a final 9,714 dialogues after post-hoc quality control. Finally, we mix synthetic and real dialogues and split them into train/valid/test sets with an 8:1:1 ratio for downstream fine-tuning experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从心内科收集了256段真实世界的预问诊对话，涵盖疑似冠心病患者的主诉、现病史及相关危险因素。 预问诊阶段聚焦于信息收集，不涉及最终诊断确认。 我们将这些对话提取为种子患者画像，并通过情绪状态和沟通风格两个维度的受控扰动对其进行增强，生成了5,120个患者画像。 每个画像生成1至3段多轮对话，经事后质量控制后最终得到9,714段对话。 最后，我们将合成对话与真实对话混合，并按8:1:1的比例划分为训练集、验证集和测试集，用于下游微调实验。

sents.en: Finally, we mix synthetic and real dialogues and split them into train/valid/test sets with an 8:1:1 ratio for downstream fine-tuning experiments.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the alignment between synthetic and real pre-consultation dialogues from three perspectives: (1) Statistical Distribution Consistency , including Turns/Dialog, Sentence Length, Unique Chars, and Tokens/Turn; (2) Semantic Consistency , including Pairwise Dialogue Similarity, Paired Dialogue Similarity, and Local Coherence; and (3) Lexical Diversity , including Dist-1, Dist-2, Entropy, and Total Words (details in Appendix A.3 ). In addition, we randomly sample 50 real and synthetic dialogues for human and LLM-based evaluation (rubric in Table 5 , Appendix A.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们从三个方面评估合成与真实预问诊对话之间的一致性：(1) 统计分布一致性，包括轮次/对话、句子长度、唯一字符数和词元/轮次；(2) 语义一致性，包括成对对话相似度、配对对话相似度和局部连贯性；以及 (3) 词汇多样性，包括 Dist-1、Dist-2、熵和总词数（详见附录 A.3）。 此外，我们随机抽取 50 段真实对话和 50 段合成对话，进行人工评估和基于大语言模型的评估（评估标准见附录 A.2 表 5）。

paragraphs.en: We further evaluate downstream dialogue performance in terms of effective coverage, efficiency, turns, context utilization, repetition rate, invalid question rate, termination ability, and LLM-based evaluation (details in Appendix A.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步从有效覆盖率、效率、轮数、上下文利用率、重复率、无效问题率、终止能力以及基于大语言模型的评估等方面评估下游对话性能（详见附录 A.4）。

paragraphs.en: We compare against the following variants: 1) Raw Doctor : a Doctor Agent using only the raw schema without structured clinical process modeling; 2) Free Patient : a Patient Agent without persona conditioning; 3) Single Agent : a single agent with both structured clinical process and patient persona; 4) Minimal Agents : dual agents without structured process or persona (least constrained); 5) No QC/SR : removing rule-based and reward-based quality control and disabling selective rewriting.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of our framework, we compare CoRPS-Dial with multiple baselines across structural, semantic, and diversity metrics (Table 1 ), and further assess dialogue quality using human and LLM-based evaluation (Table 2 ). Overall, CoRPS-Dial consistently outperforms all baselines, generating more structured, coherent, and diverse dialogues. Raw Doctor produces shorter dialogues with degraded semantic coherence, highlighting the importance of explicit clinical workflow modeling. Free Patient shows reduced lexical diversity and contextual richness, indicating the need for persona conditioning to achieve realistic patient variability. Single Agent generates fluent but less diverse dialogues with more monotonous interaction patterns, while Minimal Agents exhibit unstable role transitions and poor coherence despite higher surface-level variation. No QC/SR introduces more verbosity and textual inconsistencies, demonstrating the importance of quality control and selective refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 为评估我们框架的有效性，我们将 CoRPS-Dial 与多个基线方法在结构性、语义和多样性指标上进行比较（表 1），并进一步使用人工评估和基于大语言模型的评估来评估对话质量（表 2）。 总体而言，CoRPS-Dial 始终优于所有基线方法，生成了更具结构化、连贯性和多样性的对话。 Raw Doctor 生成的对话较短且语义连贯性下降，这凸显了显式临床工作流建模的重要性。 Free Player 的词汇多样性和上下文丰富性有所降低，表明需要角色条件化才能实现真实的患者可变性。 Single Agent 生成的对话流畅但多样性较低，交互模式更为单调；而 Minimal Agents 尽管表层变化更大，却表现出不稳定的角色转换和较差的连贯性。 No QC/SR 引入了更多的冗余和文本不一致性，证明了质量控制与选择性精炼的重要性。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 summarizes evaluations on 50 real and 50 synthetic doctor–patient dialogues. DeepSeek-v2 assigns uniformly high scores to both real (8.78–9.18) and synthetic data (8.40–9.06), showing limited discrimination (<0.4 variance). In contrast, human experts produce a clear gap: real dialogues reach near-ceiling scores (9.67–10), while synthetic ones drop to 7.51–8.49, with differences up to 2.0 points. We further report Cohen’s kappa for human–LLM agreement in Appendix A.6 , observing strong consistency across all dimensions. These results suggest that while synthetic dialogues are structurally robust, LLM-based evaluation underestimates subtle quality deficiencies that human judgment captures.
paragraphs.zh: 图3总结了对50段真实和50段合成医患对话的评估结果。 DeepSeek-v2对真实数据（8.78–9.18）和合成数据（8.40–9.06）均给出相近的高分，区分能力有限（差异<0.4）。 相比之下，人类专家产生了明显的差距：真实对话接近满分（9.67–10），而合成对话降至7.51–8.49，差距最高达2.0分。 我们在附录A.6中进一步报告了人类与LLM之间一致性的Cohen's kappa，观察到各维度上均具有很强的一致性。 这些结果表明，尽管合成对话在结构上较为稳健，但基于LLM的评估低估了人类判断所能捕捉到的细微质量缺陷。

paragraphs.en: To assess the practical utility of synthetic data, we present the performance of models before and after SFT in Table 4 . Our results demonstrate that the synthetic data leads to substantial improvements in downstream tasks across most models, with consistent gains observed in coverage, efficiency, and dialogue control. Notably, we observe significant enhancements in models such as LLaMA-8B and DeepSeek-R1-14B. These improvements suggest that synthetic dialogues provide valuable supervision, particularly when aligned with model capacity and appropriate training configurations. Our findings reinforce that synthetic data is both effective and transferable, though the benefits are maximized with tailored fine-tuning strategies specific to each model architecture.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估合成数据的实际效用，我们在表 4 中展示了模型在 SFT 前后的性能。 我们的结果表明，合成数据使大多数模型的下游任务取得了显著提升，在覆盖率、效率和对话控制方面均观察到一致的增益。 值得注意的是，我们观察到 LLaMA-8B 和 DeepSeek-R1-14B 等模型有显著增强。 这些提升表明，合成对话提供了有价值的监督信号，尤其是当其与模型能力及合适的训练配置相匹配时。 我们的研究结果进一步证实，合成数据既有效又具有可迁移性，尽管只有针对每种模型架构采用定制化的微调策略，才能最大化其收益。

paragraphs.en: We present CoRPS-Dial, a framework for generating high-quality clinical dialogues by combining structured workflow, personalized patient personas, dual-agent interaction, and two-stage post-hoc quality control. Our method addresses role inconsistency, process redundancy, semantic drift, and textual noise in synthetic dialogue generation. Evaluations show CoRPS-Dial outperforms all baselines, producing coherent, clinically faithful, and diverse dialogues. Case studies further demonstrate improved role consistency and workflow fidelity. CoRPS-Dial offers a scalable, reliable approach to constructing clinical dialogues, enabling future research on controllable, data-centric medical conversational systems.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 CoRPS-Dial，这是一个通过结合结构化工作流程、个性化患者画像、双智能体交互以及两阶段事后质量控制来生成高质量临床对话的框架。 我们的方法解决了合成对话生成中的角色不一致、流程冗余、语义漂移和文本噪声问题。 评估表明，CoRPS-Dial 优于所有基线方法，能够生成连贯、临床忠实且多样化的对话。 案例研究进一步证明了角色一致性和工作流程保真度的提升。 CoRPS-Dial 提供了一种可扩展、可靠的临床对话构建方法，为未来可控、以数据为中心的医疗对话系统研究奠定了基础。

paragraphs.en: While CoRPS-Dial shows strong performance in generating clinically grounded dialogues, there remains room for further improvement and extension. First, hallucination in LLMs remains difficult to eliminate; future work may improve reliability by incorporating expert validation or external knowledge. Second, current validation focuses on CHD, and extending it to other diseases could assess generalizability. Third, using single-institution data may introduce bias; incorporating multi-center data could enhance diversity. Lastly, although the framework is aimed at academic research, it has potential for future clinical deployment.

paragraphs.en: This study involves real-world clinical pre-consultation dialogues and was conducted in accordance with institutional regulations for human-subject research and medical data governance. All participants provided informed consent prior to recording. To protect privacy, all data were de-identified before processing by removing or replacing personally identifiable information and assigning unique coded identifiers. Audio was recorded using institution-approved devices and transcribed via a locally deployed speech-to-text system to prevent external transmission. Transcripts and metadata were stored on encrypted institutional servers with strict access control, and only authorized researchers could access the raw data. Synthetic dialogues were generated exclusively from de-identified seed profiles using controlled perturbations of clinical attributes, emotional states, and communication styles. The generation process preserves statistical properties of clinical interactions without reconstructing identifiable patient information, thereby minimizing re-identification risk. The resulting dialogues and models are intended solely for research and methodological evaluation; due to potential inaccuracies or hallucinations in generative models, they are not designed for direct clinical decision-making without professional oversight.

sents.en: This section focuses on procedures for surface-level noise filtering arising from speech disfluencies, interruptions, and non-clinical content.
sents.zh: 本节重点介绍针对表层噪声的过滤流程，这些噪声来自言语不流畅、打断以及非临床内容。

sents.en: All filtering is applied conservatively to ensure that clinically relevant information remains.
sents.zh: 所有过滤均采用保守方式应用，以确保临床相关信息得以保留。

sents.en: The filtering steps includes:
sents.zh: 过滤步骤包括：

paragraphs.en: Eliminate filler words (e.g., “um”, “uh”) and self-corrections that do not affect clinical meaning.
paragraphs.zh: 去除填充词（例如"嗯"、"呃"）以及不影响临床含义的自我更正。

paragraphs.en: Preserve repeated mentions of symptoms if they convey emphasis.
paragraphs.zh: 如果症状的重复提及起到强调作用，请予以保留。

paragraphs.en: Discard speaker turns that consist solely of social interactions, greetings, or unrelated chit-chat.
paragraphs.zh: 丢弃仅由社交互动、问候或无关闲聊组成的说话者轮次。

paragraphs.en: Short utterances (< 3 tokens) without medical entities are considered for removal.
paragraphs.zh: 无医学实体的短话语（少于 3 个词元）将被考虑移除。

paragraphs.en: Clinically relevant tokens, symptom mentions, and temporal indicators are retained.
paragraphs.zh: 与临床相关的词元、症状提及和时间指标均被保留。

paragraphs.en: The filtering process does not modify the semantic content of the patient’s report.
paragraphs.zh: 过滤过程不会修改患者报告的语义内容。

paragraphs.en: This section presents the scoring criteria used by GLM-4-9B to evaluate synthetic dialogues (Table 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍 GLM-4-9B 用于评估合成对话的评分标准（表 5）。

paragraphs.en: This section presents the details of evaluation metrics, as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍评估指标的详细信息，如下所示：

paragraphs.en: (1) Statistical Distribution Consistency.
paragraphs.zh: (1) 统计分布一致性。

paragraphs.en: Turns / Dialog: average number of speaker turns per consultation.
paragraphs.zh: 轮次 / 对话：每次问诊中说话者轮次的平均数量。

paragraphs.en: Sentence Length: average length of sentence (in characters) per consultation.
paragraphs.zh: 句子长度：每次问诊中句子的平均长度（以字符计）。

paragraphs.en: Unique Chars: vocabulary size after removing common punctuation and whitespace.
paragraphs.zh: Unique Chars：去除常见标点和空白符后的词汇表大小。

paragraphs.en: Tokens / Turn: average tokenizer word pieces per turn.
paragraphs.zh: Tokens / 轮次：每轮次的平均分词器词块数。

paragraphs.en: Pairwise Similarity: mean cosine similarity between the real and synthetic.
paragraphs.zh: 成对相似度：真实数据与合成数据之间的平均余弦相似度。

paragraphs.en: Paired Similarity: mean cosine similarity between turns in a dialogue.
paragraphs.zh: 配对相似度：对话中各轮次之间的平均余弦相似度。

paragraphs.en: Local Coherence: average cosine similarity between embeddings of consecutive utterances within each dialogue.
paragraphs.zh: 局部连贯性：每个对话中相邻话语的嵌入之间的平均余弦相似度。

paragraphs.en: Dist-1: number of unique unigrams (single words) divided by the total number of unigrams in the generated text.
paragraphs.zh: Dist-1：唯一一元词（单个词）的数量除以生成文本中一元词的总数。

paragraphs.en: Dist-2: number of unique bigrams (pairs of consecutive words) divided by the total number of bigrams in the generated text.
paragraphs.zh: Dist-2：唯一二元组（相邻词对）的数量除以生成文本中二元组的总数。

paragraphs.en: Entropy: average word-level entropy of the generated text, where higher values indicate more uniform word distribution and greater lexical richness.
paragraphs.zh: 熵：生成文本的平均词级熵，数值越高表示词语分布越均匀、词汇丰富度越大。

paragraphs.en: Total Words: total number of words (tokens) produced across all generated text.
paragraphs.zh: 总词数：所有生成文本中产生的单词（token）总数。

paragraphs.en: This section defines the metrics for evaluating downstream dialogue performance. The following metrics are considered:
paragraphs.zh: 本节定义用于评估下游对话性能的指标。 考虑以下指标：

sents.en: This section defines the metrics for evaluating downstream dialogue performance.
sents.zh: 本节定义用于评估下游对话性能的指标。

sents.en: The following metrics are considered:
sents.zh: 考虑以下指标：

paragraphs.en: Effective Coverage measures whether the model captures key medical information.
paragraphs.zh: 有效覆盖率衡量模型是否捕捉到关键医疗信息。

paragraphs.en: Efficiency measures the model’s ability to gather sufficient information within limited dialogue turns.
paragraphs.zh: 效率衡量的是模型在有限的对话轮次内收集充分信息的能力。

paragraphs.en: Context Utilization measures whether the model leverages the patient’s most recent responses to guide follow-up questions.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文利用率（Context Utilization）衡量的是模型是否利用患者最近的回答来指导后续提问。

paragraphs.en: Repetition Rate measures the extent of repeated or redundant questioning.
paragraphs.zh: 重复率衡量重复或冗余提问的程度。

paragraphs.en: Invalid Question Rate measures the proportion of irrelevant or unnecessary questions generated by the model.
paragraphs.zh: 无效问题率衡量模型生成的无关或不必要问题的比例。

paragraphs.en: Termination Ability measures whether the model appropriately concludes the consultation once sufficient information is collected.
paragraphs.zh: 终止能力衡量模型在收集到足够信息后是否能恰当地结束问诊。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based Evaluation measures overall consultation quality using an independent LLM, including Coherence (logical consistency), Relevance (alignment with clinical context), Clinical Logic (medical correctness and reasoning), Informativeness (usefulness of information), and Fluency (naturalness and readability).
paragraphs.zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的评估使用一个独立的 LLM 来衡量整体会诊质量，包括连贯性（逻辑一致性）、相关性（与临床情境的契合度）、临床逻辑（医学正确性与推理）、信息量（信息的有用性）以及流畅性（自然度与可读性）。

paragraphs.en: We provide a detailed analysis of the structural, semantic, and diversity properties of synthetic dialogues across different dataset sizes, as shown in Table 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们对不同数据集规模下合成对话的结构、语义和多样性属性进行了详细分析，如表3所示。

paragraphs.en: Structural Properties. Real-world dialogues exhibit substantial variability in turns per dialogue (34.26 ± 12.3) and sentence length (33.53 ± 74.29), reflecting the flexible nature of human clinical conversations. In contrast, synthetic dialogues show more stable structural patterns across all scales, with approximately 42 turns per dialogue and significantly lower variance. Synthetic dialogues also contain longer sentences and more tokens per turn, indicating more explicit and detailed utterances. The number of unique characters increases steadily with size, suggesting growing lexical coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 结构特性。 真实对话在每段对话的轮数（34.26 ± 12.3）和句子长度（33.53 ± 74.29）上表现出较大的变异性，反映了人类临床对话的灵活性。 相比之下，合成对话在所有规模下都表现出更稳定的结构模式，每段对话约为 42 轮，且方差明显更低。 合成对话还包含更长的句子和每轮更多的词元，表明其表达更加明确和详细。 唯一角色的数量随规模稳步增加，表明词汇覆盖率不断提升。

paragraphs.en: Semantic Consistency. Synthetic dialogues achieve consistently high semantic similarity across all scales (Pairwise Sim ≈ \approx 0.924, Paired Sim ≈ \approx 0.922), demonstrating that semantic structure is preserved even in small subsets. Local coherence is also higher than in real-world dialogues (0.593–0.594 vs. 0.536), indicating that structured generation enhances turn-level coherence. Notably, these semantic metrics remain stable as size increases, suggesting that quality does not degrade with scale.

paragraphs.en: Diversity Analysis. While real-world dialogues show higher Dist-1 and Dist-2 due to unconstrained language use, synthetic dialogues exhibit a gradual decrease in these metrics as size increases, reflecting repeated clinical patterns. However, lexical entropy remains stable (8.26–8.27), indicating preserved lexical richness. Total word count grows linearly with size, confirming that large-scale synthetic generation expands textual resources for downstream training.

paragraphs.en: To assess the impact of emotion and communication styles, we select exactly one representative dialogue per portrait of the augmented patient profile, for a total of 5,120 dialogues, as shown in Table 6 .
paragraphs.zh: 为评估情感与沟通风格的影响，我们从增强后的患者档案的每个画像中恰好选取一个代表性对话，共计 5,120 个对话，如表 6 所示。

paragraphs.en: Structural and Semantic Consistency. Synthetic dialogues maintain consistent turns per dialogue (42) and sentence length across all sampling scales, with low variance compared to real-world dialogue. Local coherence and pairwise similarity remain high (0.593–0.596), indicating that varying emotion and expression style do not disrupt the underlying semantic structure. These results demonstrate that dialogue expansion through style variation preserves the integrity of the clinical content while generating diverse surface realizations.
paragraphs.zh: 结构与语义一致性。 合成对话在所有采样规模下保持每个对话的轮数（42）和句子长度一致，与真实世界对话相比方差较低。 局部连贯性和成对相似性保持较高水平（0.593–0.596），表明改变情感和表达风格不会破坏底层语义结构。 这些结果表明，通过风格变化进行的对话扩展在生成多样化表层表达的同时，保留了临床内容的完整性。

This shows that the variations in emotion and expression style introduce linguistic diversity without creating bias or artificial repetition in the core clinical information. The linear growth in total words further confirms that the expanded scales are appropriately expanded.

paragraphs.en: These findings suggest that profile-based expansion is a safe and effective strategy to increase size, introducing natural variability in patient expression while preserving clinical fidelity. Importantly, small subsets of the expanded dialogues reliably reflect the quality of the full dialogues, supporting their use in downstream dialogue modeling without introducing bias from repeated core information.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现表明，基于画像的扩展是一种安全且有效的扩充规模策略，在保持临床忠实度的同时，为患者表达引入自然的多样性。 重要的是，扩展后对话中的小子集能够可靠地反映完整对话的质量，从而支持将其用于下游对话建模，且不会因重复核心信息而引入偏差。

paragraphs.en: Raw Doctor lacks targeted symptom and risk-factor inquiry. Free Patient produces template-like responses with limited persona diversity. paragraphs.zh: 原始医生智能体缺乏针对性的症状和风险因素询问。 自由患者智能体生成的回复千篇一律，人设多样性有限。 单一智能体能生成连贯但多样性较低的交互，而极简智能体由于缺少角色和流程约束，对话容易失焦。

paragraphs.en: Although No QC/SR benefits from structured workflows, personas, and dual-agent interaction, it still exhibits role inconsistency, incomplete or redundant steps, and textual noise. Our method generates more consistent roles, coherent interaction flows, and cleaner language through post-hoc quality control and selective refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 No QC/SR 受益于结构化工作流、角色设定以及双智能体交互，但它仍然存在角色不一致、步骤不完整或冗余以及文本噪声的问题。 我们的方法通过事后质量控制与选择性精炼，生成更加一致的角色、更连贯的交互流程以及更简洁的语言。
